verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing page documents a Free plan at $0/month with 250 searches per month, enough for a developer to prototype. Cached searches (1-hour cache) are free and do not count toward the monthly quota, which stretches the allowance during iteration. Missing for 10: documentation of free-tier restrictions (which engines or features are included, rate limits, whether a card is required), and independent or hands-on corroboration of prototyping on the free plan.
